articles.title: Take-Two requests subpoenas over GTA VI gameplay leaks
articles.summary: Take-Two Interactive requested to be able to subpoena Microsoft and Discord to identify “alleged infringers” following seemingly leaked gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto VI.
articles.body: Following several apparent video leaks of Grand Theft Auto VI, Take-Two Interactive requested to be able to subpoena Microsoft and Discord over content that “infringes copyrights” held for the game, Kotaku reports. In the requests, filed on Thursday, Take-Two says copyrighted material includes “audiovisual content, artwork, images, dialogue, or other creative elements” and it is looking to identify “alleged infringers at issue.” The requests give Microsoft and Discord until September 4th to produce the requested information. The requests were approved on Friday. However, Discord marketing director Ryan Rigney said on Monday that the company “has not yet been served with a subpoena from Take Two.” On X, Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet said Friday that “We are working closely with Take-Two and Rockstar Games to support efforts to protect creative works and intellectual property.” The leaked clips have been watermarked by a person or group going by “CyberLeek,” and they have shown what appears to be GTA VI protagonist Jason Duval (one of two protagonists) doing various activities, including driving, flying an airplane, using a taser, and attacking somebody with a wrench. In one clip, the player spells “LEEK” by shooting holes in a wall. Take-Two also filed requests to subpoena Google and X on Friday. The leaks have popped up ahead of Rockstar’s big extended preview of the game that is set to debut on Netflix on August 27th. The full game is scheduled to launch on November 19th. Update, August 21st: Added statement from Xbox’s CTO. Update and Correction, August 24th: Revised the article to clarify that Take-Two requested the subpoenas, not that it issued them. Also added that Discord says it has not received a subpoena and that Take-Two has filed requests to subpoena Google and X.

Instituição oferece curso gratuito de desenvolvimento de jogos — Foto: Divulgação/Arquivo

O Instituto Federal de Sergipe ( IFS ) está com inscrições abertas para 180 vagas em um programa gratuito de formação em desenvolvimento de jogos digitais.

A iniciativa oferece bolsas que podem chegar a R$ 2 mil por mês nas etapas mais avançadas da capacitação. Em Sergipe, as atividades serão vinculadas aos polos de Aracaju e Nossa Senhora do Socorro. A formação terá duração total de 16 meses e será dividida em três etapas.

Podem se inscrever estudantes de cursos técnicos integrados ao ensino médio ou subsequentes de escolas e institutos federais de Sergipe, nas áreas de jogos digitais, informática e cursos relacionados. É necessário estar no último ano ou semestre da formação.

Além dos alunos de cursos técnicos, estudantes de universidades e faculdades matriculados em cursos de jogos digitais, ciência da computação, engenharias, ciências exatas e áreas afins também podem se inscrever.

articles.title: Turkey Takeover Update - Steal An Egg [Roblox] Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Turkey Takeover update adds a new timed event that you can participate in for a limited time in Steal an Egg, along with rewards that include a new
articles.body:
The Turkey Takeover update adds a new timed event that you can participate in for a limited time in Steal an Egg , along with rewards that include a new mutation, eggs , and pets . Available starting on Nov. 21. In this guide, we're going to break down everything included in the Turkey Takeover Update in Steal an Egg.

Everything in the Turkey Takeover Update

Here's a thorough breakdown of everything new in the Turkey Takeover Update.

The Turkey Rampage is a recurring event that happens every 30 minutes in Steal an Egg, at the 0:15 and 0:45 marks of every hour.

Five minutes before this event, you'll see a small notification appear on the bottom right of your screen, above where it tells you how long you have until it's nightfall, with a timer leading up to the event.

When the event happens, all players' screens will home in on a massive turkey, King Gobble, that has spawned in one of the biomes on the map. All players can head over there with their bats and begin battling against the King Gobble.

Hitting the King Gobble with a bat rewards players with feathers. A location on the King Gobble will have a crosshair, highlighting where players can land a critical hit, rewarding twice as many feathers. When King Gobble's stagger meter reaches zero, they fall down, allowing players to hit it for a short period of time without it moving around. It will get back up, spawn multiple smaller turkeys at its location, and run around. Expect to participate in this event for four minutes before King Gobble disappears.

Players are also competing to hit King Gobble the most. Players who hit the most have a chance to take away a small bundle of Feathers, such as first place getting 500, second place getting 300, and third place getting 100 feathers.

All feathers can be used in the Turkey Shop, which is on the right side of the screen underneath the eggs and pets.

These are all the rewards available that you can buy using your Feathers.

200 Feathers : Maple Mutation (10% chance)

400 Feathers : 1.25x Speed (Five minutes)

1,200 Feathers : 2x Treadmill Booster (10 Minutes)

The Royal Egg is a limited-time egg that all players can purchase using Robux. There are six types of pets available that have a chance to hatch from this egg.

You can purchase one egg for 99 Robux, three eggs for 249 Robux, 10 eggs for 799 Robux, and 50 eggs for 3,499 Robux.

articles.body:
Crocs launched its first Animal Crossing-themed clog last year . The official Nintendo collaboration sold out in minutes, and only the teeny-tiny kid's edition has been popping in and out of stock ever since. Until now.

Right after launching its official Black Friday sale , Amazon has brought back a few select sizes of the adult Animal Crossing clog . The retailer has also knocked over $30 off the price of each shoe, bringing the Crocs well below their previous lowest price.

Animal Crossing Crocs Are Back and Cheaper Than Ever

The Animal Crossing clog captures plenty of the New Horizons charm in its design. The clog generally sticks to soft pastel tones, with ocean wave details along the platform foundation. A collage of Animal Crossing’s many trees coat the front of the shoe, while fluffy clouds and a little red balloon float on the ankle strap.

The base clog also comes with seven exclusive Jibbitz. Four of the Jibbitz depict characters: Isabelle, K.K. Slider, Tom Nook, and the joint tanuki Timmy and Tommy. Three more charms depict a classic villager house, an apple tree, and a good ol’ bag of Bells.

Additional villager Jibbitz are on sale directly through Crocs , which is also hosting its own Black Friday sale . For whatever reason, Crocs itself didn't pull off the full clog restock.

Amazon has also dropped the 'little kids' edition from $54.95 to $33 , the same 40% discount as the adult size on an already cheaper shoe.

Nintendo’s Black Friday sale has already dropped, offering the only console deal for 2026 . We’re also seeing big discounts on first-party Switch 2 games like Donkey Kong Bananza , which we considered a masterpiece .

Speaking of masterpieces, GTA 6 just dropped. While we’re not seeing any Black Friday discounts on the game or the consoles it plays on , we’re still keeping an eye out for the cheapest ways to get in on the action — and are finding plenty more gaming deals in the meantime.

articles.title: Rockstar Says Darts Were Cut From GTA 6 Because It Didn't Have 'Unlimited Money or Time' to Make It 'Feel Proper'
articles.summary: Rockstar Games crammed a lot of content into GTA 6, but fan-favorite mini-games like darts and bowling didn't make the cut because the team didn't have "unlimited money or unlimited time" to do those activities justice.
articles.body:
Rockstar Games crammed a lot of content into GTA 6 , but fan-favorite mini-games like darts and bowling didn't make the cut because the team didn't have "unlimited money or unlimited time" to do those activities justice.

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson explained why the studio chose to focus on some aspects of development and not others during an interview with VGC . As noted by the site, picking up a game of darts has proven to be a good pastime in games like GTA 5 and GTA Online, but in GTA 6, the standards were a bit higher.

From NPCs to the feel of motorized scooters, Leonida is Rockstar's most realistic playground yet. Every blade of grass was given special attention, and while pool was one game the team was able to fully realize, not everything panned out like they had hoped. Nelson said "darts was a contentious one" when talking about the decision to cut it from the game, explaining that it was left behind because the team didn't have the resources to do it right.

"Even we… you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not and so sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to," he said.

Nelson elaborated, saying that, starting with Red Dead Redemption 2, the team started to treat mini-games more like activities. In other words, bonuses like darts became less about being a diversion of Rockstar's open worlds and more of an extension of them. The goal is to make pool, darts, or any other activity feel like it's just as punchy and weighty for Jason and Lucia as it is in the real world.

Using GTA 6's in-game workouts as an example, he added, "You’re not just pushing a button; it mimics what weightlifting is."

"A lot of work [is needed] to get it tuned right," Nelson continued. "Darts is one we just didn’t get to."

Long story short, Rockstar just "didn't have the resources" to make it "feel proper." His thoughts on the matter – or any scenario where a mechanic or activity is cut – were summed up in one line: "It’s better not to do it than to do it and have it not be good enough."

GTA 6 is now the highest-rated game of all time . IGN gave it a 10/10 review .

For one of the better examples of the care the developers put into side activities, look no further than some of the games Jason has on his JoySystem . You can see how Rockstar pulled from real-world inspirations to create his character here .

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

articles.title: Save $400 on Ecovacs' Flagship Robot Vacuum, the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone, for Black Friday
articles.summary: Continuously self-cleaning mops, a self-sufficient base, and more leave floors sparkling while you enjoy the holiday season.
articles.body:
The holidays are upon us. That means lots of festivities and activities, leaving you busier and your home messier. A robot vacuum can make cleanup a little easier, and for Black Friday, Ecovacs has marked down its flagship model, the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone. It’s just $899.99, $400 off the list price. A solid deal for one of the most innovative and capable robot vacuums out there. We’re talking a top-tier, unique mopping system, superior suction power, incredible edge cleaning, and a self-sufficient base station, giving you more time to enjoy the season.

Save $400 on the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone Robot Vacuum

Ecovacs has been in the robot vacuum game for nearly two decades, and I’ve tested a few of their models. It remains one of my favorite brands because of its intuitive mapping and reliable performance. While I haven’t tried the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone, its feature set doesn’t disappoint. If you want serious cleaning power, it's the robot vacuum to get.

Unlike other robot vacuums that just wet the mopping pads and go out to clean, essentially just spreading dirty mopping pads across your floor. The Deebot X12S packs the Ozmo Roller, which continuously cleans itself as it mops. That’s paired with incredible scrubbing power featuring 4000Pa downward pressure and 220RPM. To make things even better, a FocusJet Pre-dissolving feature can target and break down tougher spills before mopping.

It’s not just the mopping ability that makes the Deebot X12S a superior robot vacuum. The vacuum offers up to 18,000Pa suction power to pick up debris, making it great not just for hard floors but also carpets and rugs. The roller mop won’t get carpets and rugs wet either, as it lifts and has a cover. For edges, TruEdge 3.0 tech lets the roller extend beyond the robot vacuum’s body to reach under recessed cabinets, baseboards, and more.

When needed, during cleaning, and after it finishes a job, the Deebot X12S returns to the base station. There, it hot-water power-washes and dries the mops and empties the robot’s dust box. It even offers bagless self-emptying, so you won’t need to worry about replacement bags down the road.

Those are just a few of the highlights of the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone. Whether you buy it for yourself or give it as a gift, it’s sure to be one of your most useful purchases this holiday.

articles.title: GTA 6 Dev Honors Late Mother With In-Game Memorial That Players Can Visit
articles.summary: A GTA 6 developer has paid tribute to his late mother with an in-game memorial in Leonida that players can find and visit for themselves.
articles.body:
A GTA 6 developer has paid tribute to his late mother with an in-game memorial in Leonida that players can find and visit themselves.

Rockstar Games QA developer Matt Green shared the touching story of how his mother helped launch his career in game development and the way she was honored in the Grand Theft Auto universe with a post on Instagram. Although she passed eight months before GTA 6's launch last week, Rockstar still managed to include her in a wall of other names in a memorial located in Leonida.

"As a kid, I remember practically begging my Mum to let me get GTA: Vice City and even though she was understandably reluctant, she caved," Green said. "I think that decision is likely what set me on the path to eventually working at Rockstar Games and on GTA VI.

"She was super proud and excited to see what I'd been working on but unfortunately I never got to show her. She's been gone almost 8 months now and sometimes it still doesn't feel real."

The memorial, which Green said can be found "just north of Hamlet, shows that Bev Green passed in March 2026, and she's joined by a collection of other names, too. It's unclear if every name on the memorial is tied to another Rockstar developer's lost loved one or who the names may be referencing, but we know at least two other names are.

Production designer Terrance Radcliff took to X/Twitter to share how the team had immortalized his father and daughter, who both passed during GTA 6's development. Elhuntry Radcliff and Jade Radcliff can be seen next to each other in-game.

"To wrap up launch week, what an honor to see my Father and my first Daughter, Jade, both of who I lost during development, forever immortalized in GTA VI," Radcliff said. "To have them be a part of such a huge moment in gaming history means everything to me. Peace & blessings."

articles.title: Take Out Kitty Litter - All Lab Locations - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Looking for all the Kitty Litter Lab locations? Find them all here with this official GTA 6 guide. After completing the Here, Kitty Kitty mission in Chapter 3,
articles.body:
Looking for all the Kitty Litter Lab locations? Find them all here with this official GTA 6 guide . After completing the Here, Kitty Kitty mission in Chapter 3 , Tyrone and his partner Dook send Jason on the hunt to destroy 20 Kitty Litter labs . He'll pay you for every lab you destroy. This is tracked under the Robberies index in the map, with every lab located somewhere in Vice City. Tyrone will occasionally send you locations of labs.

Have you destroyed all the labs? Keep track of them here. As always, this guide serves as to suggest ways to complete the mission. You may approach labs and destroy them in the way that best suits you.

Kitty Litter Lab - East La Perle Trailer

Kitty Litter Lab - West La Perle Trailer

Kitty Litter Lab - North Crosstown Lockup

East La Perle Trailer – Kitty Litter Labs Introduction

After completing Here, Kitty Kitty, Dook will eventually text Jason the location of the first Kitty Litter lab target. This will be in northern Vice City, just a few blocks north of Tyrone – it will be marked on your map. Once you complete this lab, you are free to complete the remaining 20 right after.

Location : East La Perle, Northwest Vice City

Follow the waypoint to the lab and approach from the northwest side. The entire area will be shaded in purple, indicating that you will need to find the location of the lab yourself – these are how all of these will be. As you approach from the northwest, you’ll see a green gate that you can go through. Once through the gate, take an immediate right.

Looking forward, you’ll see a white van on your left. Make a left after passing the van.

Right next to the van after turning left, you’ll see a green house with purple smoke with some men out front. This is the synthetic lab you’re looking for.

You can either shoot the guys to gain entry or knock them out. Shooting them leads the cops to your location faster as someone nearby will report the shooting. Once inside the house, you’ll see the lab, shoot one of the glass beakers to start a fire and then leave the trailer before it explodes.

Once the lab explodes, leave the area and Jason will call Dook to let him know that the lab is destroyed. Once this happens, you can periodically talk to Tyrone to ask him where more locations are. But at this point, you can find all Kitty Litter labs in GTAVI.

Location : Northeast Crosstown, North Vice City

Approach the search area from the south to see the laundry van parked near the entrance to the apartment plaza. Go through the entrance.

Once through the entrance, look left to spot the purple cans in front of a white door on the second floor. The lab will be inside that door, in apartment 103 .

Location: North Rockridge, Central Vice City

When entering from the north, you’ll see Peterson’s Autoshop. Run in front of it and circle around to the left, which will put you on the right side of the shop.

To the right of the front of the shop is the laundry van. You’ll need to enter the van and move it forward to reveal the door to the lab.

Once the van is pulled forward, it’ll reveal a shutter. Open the shutter to enter the lab.

Location : Rockridge, Central-North of Vice City

When approaching from the north, you’ll see an open gate with the laundry van parked to the left. On the right side of the parking lot, climb the stairs to get to the second floor.

Once upstairs, enter apartment 5, which is the middle grey door. The lab will be inside.

Location : Southwest La Perle, Vice City

When approaching West La Perle trailer from the east, go through the double-wide gate to enter the trailer park. The last trailer on the right is the lab.

Just be aware that as you approach the trailer, there will be a man on the couch out front as well as two women talking. As you approach, they will open fire, so you’ll need to take them out. There will be one more person inside the trailer, but they typically will run away. Enter the trailer and destroy the lab.

Location : Southwest Balsero, West Vice City

When approaching from the southeast, you’ll see a road entrance into the trailer park. Enter through that entrance and turn left at the cross section.

A way down on the left will be a green-trim trailer with purple smoke emitting from the top. That's the lab.

Once you’re at the trailer, you’ll see the laundry van in front of the door to the trailer. Enter the trailer to destroy the lab

When approaching from the northeast, you’ll see the laundry van parked to the right, next to a fence. Go to the van to enter the alley.

With the laundry van to your left, look ahead to see a man standing in front of a gate. Take the man out and go through the gate. There will be a couple more lab members that will open fire. Take them out and enter the lab, which is to the left of the kitty image.

Location : Central-East Balsero, Vice City

When approaching from the north, you’ll see the laundry van next to a large gate. Enter the gate and approach the shutter. Where the lab is located.

The shutter will have a keypad next to it, and above it is the word "billboard", with an arrow pointing to the right, hinting at where to find the code. Look to your right to see a purple billboard with a man pointing. The phone number for his office is 1-999-FEMINIST. The keypad code to open the Balsero lab shutter is 1999 . Enter the code and destroy the lab.

Location : Southwest Decor Disctrict, Northeast Vice City

When approaching from the south, simply run through the parking lot toward the shutter. Open the shutter, there will be a man inside that you can dismiss him and then destroy the lab.

Location : East-Central Little Cuba, Central Vice City

When approaching the west, you’ll see the laundry van in front of some apartments. Enter the apartment complex and the lap will be the second door on the left.

Location: South Salton, South-Central Vice City

When approaching from the west, you’ll see the laundry van in front of a two-story apartment building. The lab is the second door on the top floor, the one without caution tape. But it’s locked. So go around the right side of the building to get to the back of the complex.

Once in the back of the apartment, climb the green dumpster which is under an open window. Climb through the open window to find the lab. There will be a man in there that will attack you.

Location: Northeast Salton, Central Vice City

Approaching from the very southwest tip of the search area, you’ll see a big parking lot with two laundry vans. Jump the fence that’s across the parking lot, then turn left and go through the gate to arrive at the van on the left. In the image below, it’ll be marked as Van 1 .

After getting to the van, you’ll see it parked next to a man and a shutter. The man will attack you, so take him out and open the shutter to find the lab.

Location : West Tequesta, Southeast Vice City

Approach the search area from the east and you’ll see the van in front of an apartment complex with two sets of stairs. Follow the stairs to the right up to the second floor and the lab will be the door right in front of you when at the top of the stairs.

Location : West Crosstown, Central Vice City

Approach the search area from the east to see the laundry van. Run past the van down the alley to see a building with yellow shutter doors. The correct one is right to the left of the alley, to the left of the kitty picture.

Approach the search area from the northeast to see a long path through a trailer park. Go down the path until you reach the car. If the car is not there for you, then just follow the line in the image below.

Once you’re near the car, there will be a white trailer with one of its windows open. Enter through the window and go into the next room in the trailer to find the lab. You can break out of the front door from the inside to leave.

Location : Central Crosstown, East Vice City

Approach the search area from the west to see the laundry van parked in the parking lot of a tattoo parlor. Head toward the van and enter the area the van is facing.

Behind the tattoo parlor is a brown shutter door with a man in front of it. The man will attack you so take him out. Open the shutter door to find the lab.

Location : Central Rockridge, Central Vice City

Approach the search area from the southwest and you’ll see the laundry van in a parking lot. Make your way down the parking lot until you can go right around the building.

Once you look right, you’ll see a brown shutter door with the lab inside.

Location : East Rockridge, Central Vice City

Approach the search area from the south to see the laundry van parked outside an apartment complex. Ran past the left of the van to find yourself to the side of the complex with four doors.

The lab will be inside the white door on the bottom floor.

Location : North Crosstown, Central Vice City

Approach the search area from the north and you’ll see the laundry van parked in front of an apartment complex. Go to the right of the van to enter the parking lot.

In the parking lot, climb the stairs to get to the second floor, and the lab will be in the white door all the way to the right.

Approach the search area from the southeast. You’ll see the laundry can in front of a shutter door. Open the shutter door to find the lab.

articles.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Plows Through GTA 6 Hype With $225 Million Opening Weekend
articles.summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping took GTA 6 players off of their couches and into movie theaters with a staggering estimated box office total of $225 million in its opening weekend.
articles.body:
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping took GTA 6 players off of their couches and into movie theaters with a staggering estimated box office total of $225 million in its opening weekend.

The latest prequel in Suzanne Collins' run of Hunger Games adaptations attracted more than just fans, pulling in a whopping $125 million domestically and $105 million internationally following its November 20 release date. It's an impressive debut that proved the dystopia franchise has more than enough staying power, even in the face of the biggest entertainment launch of all time .

Attracting moviegoers to take a break from Vice City this weekend was star Joseph Zada (We Were Liars), who stars as a young Haymitch Abernathy to tell the story of the Second Quarter Quell and the impact it had on the Hunger Games for all time. A brutal flick that IGN gave an 8/10 review , Sunrise on the Reaping is an adaptation of Collins' book of the same name, which originally released in March 2025. Its star-studded cast also includes Jesse Plemons (Game Night) as Plutarch Heavensbee, Ralph Fiennes (28 Years Later) as President Snow, Glenn Close (Fatal Attraction) as Drusilla Sickle, Mckenna Grace (Five Nights at Freddy's 2) as Maysilee Donner, and more.

"The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is one of the strongest entries of the franchise because of its excellent performances," we said in our review, "especially Joseph Zada’s compassionate turn as young Haymitch. It also closes the story of Panem on a high note."

The mainline Hunger Games movies took a break after catching up with the Katniss Everdeen saga that began with Collins' books. The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes, a novel focused on a teenage Coriolanus Snow, launched in 2020 and was adapted into a film of the same name in 2023. That project, which starred Billy the Kid's Tom Blyth, landed atop the box office upon its debut, though with decidedly softer results that saw its global opening weekend reach $98.5 million .

Sunrise on the Reaping has now brought the focus back to the good guys, and to much success. The new Hunger Games movie had a hefty production budget of $150 million, according to Variety . With plenty of time left in theaters before heavy hitters like Dune: Part 3 and Avengers: Doomsday sweep theaters mid-December, Lionsgate is almost certainly happy with its first few days.

The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes Gallery

Despite appealing enough to moviegoers to sneak in an explosive theatrical debut right under GTA's nose, there's actually no word on whether audiences will see a new story set in Panem anytime soon. Collins has not announced any additional books set in that universe as of right now, but with so many characters and stories ripe for exploration, it probably wouldn't be too much of a surprise to see The Hunger Games back in theaters at some point.

Elsewhere at the box office for the late November weekend was Johnny Depp's Ebenezer , which racked up another $22 million. The grim Christmas Carol reimagining earned $42 million worldwide when it premiered last weekend. IGN gave it a 6/10 review . The top five box office earners and their global totals for the weekend are as follows:

articles.summary: Also check out Sonos' latest and greatest 2026 product releases.
articles.body:
Sonos R&D has been busy in 2026 with a bevy of new releases, both revolutionary and evolutionary. On the software front, Sonos released its new Sonos 27 home audio operating system earlier in September. It merges all of Sonos' speakers into one centralized control system with AI integration. On the hardware front, Sonos released the Era 100 SL speaker, Sonos Play portable speaker, Beam Ultra soundbar, and Ace Ultra headphones. Of those products, the latter two deserve the spotlight as we head into the holiday season.

The Sonos Beam Ultra is more than just an incremental upgrade over its Gen 2 predecessor. Like the Arc Ultra compared to the Arc , this is practically an entirely different soundbar. Although the size profile isn't much different (29 inches long vs 25 inches), the Beam Ultra now houses a total of nine total speakers instead of five. This improves the Beam's surround sound capabilities two-fold: (1) it is now technically a 7.1.2ch system instead of 5.1.2ch and (2) it has two physical upfiring speakers for true Dolby Atmos support whereas the previous Beam Gen 2 used virtual height channels for a simulated Atmos experience. Other upgrades include AI speech enhanced to isolate and amplify dialogue, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and USB-C line-in. It also has a microphone for voice control.

New for 2026: Sonos Ace Ultra Headphones

The Sonos Ace Ultra has also undergone major renovation, which isn't as surprising since the original Ace was Sonos' first foray into the world of over-ear headphones. The Ace Ultra is better sounding than ever before thanks to a combination of second generation custom engineered 40mm drivers and adaptive EQ that tunes the sound in real time based on how the headphones fit. Noise cancelation has also improved up to 2X with the presence of ten microphones instead of eight.

An interesting feature unique to the Sonos Ace Ultra is the replaceable battery. All lithium batteries lose maximum charge over time. And most of the time, the only solution is to replace the headphones. Sonos, however, allows you to buy a replacement battery kit that you can install yourself. It's not hard, Sonos provides instructions, and it doesn't void your warranty. although it's not completely toolless.

The official Sonos Black Friday Sale has kicked off with some massive discounts on Sonos' existing lineup of headphones, soundbars, speakers, and subs. Jump start your holiday shopping with savings of up to $250 off.

Sonos' flagship Arc Ultra soundbar drops to $849 after a $250 off discount. Given the number of upgrades, the Sonos Arc Ultra should be considered more as a new class of flagship soundbar than a mere update of the original Arc. Whereas the original Arc featured a 5.0.2ch setup with eleven speakers and no sub, the Arc Ultra boasts an expanded 9.4.1ch setup with fourteen speakers including a four-motor, dual-membrane Sound Motion woofer for better bass response and low end. This is a pretty significant upgrade alone especially if you don't plan on adding a discrete subwoofer.

The Sonos Sub 4 drops to $749 after a $150 off discount. The audio savvy knows that a single speaker isn't enough to reproduce an entire soundstage. If you could pick only one other speaker, then a subwoofer would make the most meaningful impact. The Sub 4 features dual inward-facing 5"x8" woofers and a ported design. Improvements over the Sub 3 include a faster processor, more RAM, and Wi-Fi 6 networking.

The Sonos Era 100 drops to $179 and the Era 100 SL to $149, both after a $40 off instant discount. The Era 100 is Sonos' most popular and most versatile speaker. The "SL" variant doesn't have a microphone, so you can't use it with a voice activated smart assistant. A common practice is to buy one Era 100 speaker and the rest Era 100 SL to save on cost.

Despite its compact size, the Era 100 houses two tweeters, a mid-woofer, and three class-D digital amplifiers to produce precise, distortion-free audio even at high volumes. It has a built-in microphone for smart functionality. Because of its flexibility, it's often paired with a sound bar or a second Era speaker.

$100 Off the Sonos Era 300 Smart Speaker

The Era 300 is down to $399 after a $100 off instant discount. It's nearly double the size and weight of an Era 100 and sounds better because of it. The Era 300 is also shaped differently, but there's a reason for that. The hourglass figure is designed to optimally arrange the six speakers so that they fire sound in all directions, enhancing Dolby Atmos and spatial audio effects. The Era 300 consist of four tweeters and two woofers paired with Class-D digital amplifiers and custom waveguides to help project sound to all corners of your room.

The Sonos Beam is a great option for someone who requires a more compact sound bar or simply doesn't want to spend $700 on the Beam Ultra. Although the Beam Ultra is a clear improvement over its predecessor, it's also more than double the current price. The Beam (Gen 2) is a 26-inch long, 5.0-channel soundbar with one tweeter and four mid-woofers for natural, balanced sound and four passive radiators to help with the low end. Although the Beam doesn't have physical height channels, it has two virtual height channels for Dolby Atmos support. It has a microphone for voice control.

$110 Off the Sonos Ace Noise Canceling Headphone

The Sonos Ace drops to the lowest price I've seen for a new, retail boxed set. It's currently $229 after a $120 off instant discount and almost exactly half the price of the Ace Ultra. This premium wireless headphone features Dolby Atmos spatial audio with dynamic head tracking, lossless audio streaming over Bluetooth, effective active noise cancellation thanks to eight optimally positioned microphones (plus Aware mode), custom designed 40mm dynamic drivers for accurate, distortion-free audio, a mix of plush memory foam and vegan leather for all-day comfort, and a stainless steel headband skeleton for durability. The battery lasts for up to 30 hours with ANC enabled and can be recharged over USB Type-C.

articles.title: Kate Bishop Actress Hailee Steinfeld Confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday.
articles.body:
Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday .

Marvel Studios announced the surprise return of Hawkeye's Disney+ partner in a nonchalant Instagram reel tonight. Serving as promotion for Steinfeld's other new Disney movie, Hexed, the video sees her jokingly say someone delivered a chair "from a different movie," but the post's caption makes things pretty clear.

"Catch Hailee Steinfeld in Disney's Hexed before she returns in Avengers: Doomsday," the post said.

You'd be forgiven for thinking Steinfeld was already included in Doomsday's already enormous lineup of superheroes and A-listers. Everyone from Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal to Tom Hiddleston has previously been confirmed to make an appearance of some kind, but Steinfeld was one of a few names to have been curiously benched up until this point.

She first appeared as the bow-wielding Kate Bishop in the Jeremy Renner-led 2021 show, Hawkeye . Aside from a The Marvels cameo and some animated voice work, Steinfeld hasn't spent too much time in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as the multiverse saga has rolled on. That won't stop her from helping out in the first chapter of its finale, though.

With the cast already stacked, it's hard to know just how prominently her character will be featured amongst the chaos. Between the Avengers, the New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men, there will likely be little room to explore how she gets along with the rest of the crew. For many, just the fact that she'll help in the fight against Doctor Doom is probably enough.

Avengers: Doomsday Poster Montage Gallery

Avengers: Doomsday premieres December 18, 2026. That's a little less than one month away, but Marvel's made it clear that it's saved plenty of surprises .

Another major MCU name was teased for the movie when VisionQuest wrapped up earlier this month. Fans are expecting at least one more trailer to drop between now and the film's premiere, and if Captain Carter actress Hayley Atwell is to be believed , we won't have to wait much longer to see it.

articles.title: Anthropic Boss Dario Amodei Reportedly Had a Dystopian Solution for Simulating a Fulfilling Life for People Who Lose Their Jobs to AI: Video Games
articles.summary: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei reportedly once suggested that video games could be the solution to political strife caused by AI-fueled joblessness.
articles.body:
Anthropic boss Dario Amodei reportedly once suggested that video games could be the solution to political strife caused by AI-fueled joblessness.

In a profile of Anthropic’s Dario and Daniela Amodei from the Wall Street Journal , it is reported that when Dario Amodei worked at OpenAI from 2016 to 2020, he allegedly suggested video games could pacify the masses after AI took their jobs.

Here’s the relevant section of the profile:

There [at OpenAI], he engaged in debates with his fellow employees, suggesting that immersive video games might be a solution for the political strife caused by AI-induced joblessness, according to widely circulated Slack messages.

The anecdote suggests a foresight from Dario Amodei about the potential of AI to cause mass layoffs, but also a rather dystopian solution that would see jobless people content to live out their lives playing video games rather than kick up a stink about losing their livelihoods.

While this section of the WSJ profile mentioned Amodei’s alleged thoughts on this issue from some time ago (potentially a decade ago), and he may have changed his mind since then, it’s interesting to consider his mindset in the context of growing concern around mass layoffs as companies turn to AI to replace human workers to save money and, they claim, boost productivity.

Survey data from Pew Research Center published in September showed how ordinary people around the world are worried about the economic impact of AI. In 34 of 37 countries Pew Research Center surveyed earlier this year , people tend to believe AI will lead to fewer jobs rather than more jobs. And people are getting more worried about this over time. In the U.S., the share of people who believe AI will result in job loss over the next 20 years increased seven percentage points in two years.

The profile also has a delicious timing, coming as it does around the launch of GTA 6 , a game that you’d imagine Dario Amodei might have considered to be a video game "immersive enough" to pacify the jobless masses long term.

Reaction online to the profile is, predictably, a mix of outrage and mockery, with some posting The Matrix and Ready Player One memes in response. "Unless we’d get paid for playing video games, I don’t see how that would work. Boredom isn’t the problem with joblessness," one person said. “How do people buy games if they don't have a job that pays them?” another wondered.

The answer from people who are convinced of our AI-powered future to that common retort is, as Elon Musk is fond of saying, abundance for all. Musk believes that AI will create a post-scarcity economy where goods and services have become so plentiful that labor and money become redundant. In such an economy, no-one would need a job, because, so the theory goes, everyone has all they could ever want at the push of a button — for free.

In such an economy, could video games keep everyone occupied enough to prevent political strife? Could a game like GTA 6 keep you busy… forever?

articles.title: Twin Flames - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Once you've visited both protests in the Sisters of the Sea and Bring Out the Chimp missions, as part of the Dodos Rising chain of optional missions, the
articles.body:
Once you've visited both protests in the Sisters of the Sea and Bring Out the Chimp missions, as part of the Dodos Rising chain of optional missions , the overall task will converge in the fracking mission, Twin Flames . You're once again working with the animal rights activist group, Dodos Rising, this time to stop fracking.

Use the links below to skip to key steps:

Eventually, a dodo you haven’t met yet, Tyler, will send you a text message about fracking, and ask you to meet him in Watson Bay. A pink dodo bird will be placed on your map. Watson Bay can be found to the north of Key Lento, and west of Hamlet.

Once you arrive at the mission marker, you’ll spot a couple of men telling a woman at a gas pump that she needs to buy an Electric Vehicle. Ironic, considering the men are driving an enormous truck. After approaching the men, the man in the green shirt will tell you that he is Tyler, and the other man's name is Steve, and their plan is to sneak into a fracking site by having you drive them in the truck while they hide in the port-a-potties that are on the trailer.

After the cutscene plays, enter the truck while the men enter the port-a-potties. The GPS will automatically be set to the fracking site, so simply follow the navigation to the site and then approach the gate.

The guard will stop you to ask what you’re doing there. Target him by holding up on the D-pad to tell him that you’re there to drop off the bathrooms. He’ll lift the gate, and then you can enter the fracking site. As you approach the marker, a cutscene will play of the men leaving the port-a-potties.

Exit the truck, and Tyler will ask you to activate the fire alarm to clear the area. When looking east at the fracking machinery, you’ll see a small set of white stairs. Climb those stairs and continue down the short walkway.

Once you go down the stairs at the end of the walkway, you’ll see four valves to your left. Walk past them and turn left.

You’ll see a tall set of stairs with yellow railings to the right. Walk past them and look at the red building on your right; it’s the one with the white door. To the right of the white door is the fire alarm. Approach and interact with it to set off the alarm.

After waiting for the workers to evacuate, go back to Tyler at the truck. They will exit the bathrooms (Steve will unfortunately make a mess all over himself), and you’ll be instructed to follow Tyler. Tyler will show you the “Christmas Tree”, which is a pipe with tubes and valves on it, and he’ll ask you to wait at the tree until he finds the control panel.

He will tell you to look at the Christmas Tree and follow a black pipe with a red stripe. When looking at the tree, the pipe you’re looking for will be at the top right. It will go toward the ground and coil a bit and then be laid across the ground, and will be going into a valve. Follow the pipe to the valve and turn it to complete this step.

Returning to the tree, Tyler will tell you to look at the pink pipe, to which Steve will point out that there are two. Tyler will say that it’s the bottom pipe. You’ll need to follow the bottom pink pipe to the set of four valves.

These pipes are much harder to follow, as they are two identical pink pipes tangled in with a black pipe. But if you follow the line correctly, you get to the valves, and the valve you need to turn will be the second valve from the left.

Unfortunately, it won't matter and the valves will explode anyway. Tyler will then tell you that you need to climb up the tower to retract the drill. When looking at Tyler, you’ll see a set of green stairs with yellow railings leading up to where he is standing. Go up those stairs.

Once you’re up on the platform with Tyler, look at the yellow set of stairs directly in front of you. Climb those stairs.

Once you’re up those stairs, look left to see the drill. There will be a small set of stairs in front of you, and to the right of those stairs, you’ll see a ladder you can climb. Climb up the ladder to reach the upper level of the drill.

Now that you’re up on the platform, go around to the left to the pink marker to retract the drill. Once you do that, the drill will explode, and a giant metal rod will land on Steve, trapping him underneath. Go back down the ladder and rush back over to Tyler who will be trying to help Steve.

As you approach Tyler and Steve, Tyler will stop trying to help and monologue about how Steve’s death was meant to be. The mission prompt will tell you to follow Tyler, but instead of giving up, approach the bar to lift it off Steve. Once Steve is free, interact with him to pick him up.

After picking Steve up off the ground and flinging him onto your back, carry him to Tyler. As you approach Tyler, a cutscene will play showing the drill exploding, and Tyler will catch fire and die. Once you regain control of your character, run to the marker to escape the fracking site. Once you make it to the marker, the ending cutscene for this mission will be played.

Despite what cutscene you got, the fracking mission is now over.

articles.title: Dodo, Rise! - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After disrupting the fracking during Twin Flames, as part of the Dodos Rising chain of optional missions, you're ready for the finale mission, Dodo, Rise!
articles.body:
After disrupting the fracking during Twin Flames , as part of the Dodos Rising chain of optional missions , you're ready for the finale mission, Dodo, Rise! You're once again working with the animal rights activist group, Dodos Rising, this time on a mission of your own.

Use the links below to skip to key steps:

Starting the Dodo, Rise! Optional Mission

After completing the fracking mission, Twin Flames , you will eventually receive a text message from an unknown sender telling you that it is finally time for a mission of your own. This will be the finale to the entire Dodos Rising saga. After reading the text, you can set a marker right from the message to go to Emerald Springs, which is a zoo in Keeley County, east of Port Gellhorn. Playing as Lucia, set your GPS to this marker and head there.

After following the GPS, you’ll end up in the parking lot of Emerald Springs. Continue on foot to the pink dodo marker, under the Emerald Springs sign. Continue to follow the walkway forward until you reach the ticket booth. To the right of the welcome sign, there will be a security guard. Approach and talk to him to begin the Dodo, Rise! Mission.

The man will hand you a red bag and tell you to find the asset across the park, in an incubation tank. Once you have the asset, he needs you to take it to Jeff, which the pair realizes that neither of them knows who that is.

Once Lucia picks up the bag, you’ll need to enter the zoo. As you regain control of Lucia, a couple of visitors will walk in front of you and talk about wanting to see the egg. You could follow them if you’d like, as they will lead you directly to the egg. There is no map marker placed, so you’ll need to find the egg on your own, but luckily, there is some in-world guidance.

After entering the gate, you’ll start seeing green signs advertising the egg – the signs are paid for by Sprunk, an in-world soda. As you continue down the path forward, you’ll continue to see advertisements and green arrows on the ground. Following these will lead you to the egg. You can use Focus Mode (L3 + R3) to highlight the stickers.

After passing through the ticket booth, continue down the path forward for a while until you reach a planter in the middle of the walkway. Go right past the planter to continue following the arrows on the ground.

After continuing past the planter, the road will split. Take the left walkway and continue to follow the stickers.

After following the stickers to the left, walk a couple of steps and stick to the right walkway. Continue to follow the stickers until you reach an area with several paths leading right, left, and straight. Follow the path straight.

That path will bend to the right, and then you’ll want to make a sharp left. You’ll now be under a covered walkway.

Continue down the covered walkway for a long while until the cover ends. You’ll find yourself in an area with benches and brick planters. There will be a gift shop to the right. Straight across the clearing is a Sprunk archway with an egg advertisement to the right of it. Continue under that archway.

After going under the archway, you’ll be on a wooden bridge. Follow the bridge straight until you reach a point where you can turn left or right. Turn right and continue to follow the stickers.

Continue straight until you see a building with a blue roof. This will be your destination. As you approach it, the marker for the egg will finally appear.

As you approach the building with the blue roof, look to your left to see a small glass building with a security guard in front of it. Right in the center of that building is the egg that we are after.

There’s no way around it; you’ll need to fight the guards. Even if you were to sneak perfectly, once you lift the egg, an alarm will go off, notifying the police. You can either go to the building with the blue roof, jump off the railing, and approach the dodo house from the back, or you can simply go super loud and jump right over the railing where the tourists are and run straight for the guard.

Again, it won’t matter; there is a scientist inside with the egg who will catch you, or if you approach from the back, you can take that guard out and the front guard will catch you. Either way you choose to do it, enter the room, beat up the guards, and steal the egg.

Once you pick up the egg, the alarm will go off and the doors will close. You’ll want to exit through the back door, which is the door to the right of the computer to set up with Sprunk on the monitors. Approach the door and press Square / X repeatedly to break open the door. Once you’re out, look very slightly to the left to see a fan boat. Jump on it to get your getaway from the police.

Once you’ve taken control of the fan boat, the GPS on your minimap will navigate you to Jeff. Simply follow the road on the water that the GPS gives you, making sure to avoid any other people on boats.

Once you’ve reached the end of the water navigation, park the boat on the left bank and you’ll see the pink dot which is pointing you to Jeff’s green RV. Approach it to meet Jeff.

After going to the RV, you’ll see Jeff meditating. Talking to Jeff will trigger a cutscene that shows him and Lucia entering the RV to hatch the egg. After some very questionable sounds from Jeff, the egg will hatch to reveal a newborn dodo. The dodo will bite at Jeff, but it will be nice to Lucia. As the cutscene comes to an end, the pair will receive an Amber Alert on their phones about the kidnapped dodo. The two will then leave the RV and get into Jeff's car to travel to the next destination.

Once in the car, the GPS will navigate you to your next destination, which will be the watchtower. As you drive there, you can press Right Stick Click / Right Stick Click to get a cockpit view of the dodo. While you’re looking at the dodo, the car will auto-drive, so you won’t have to worry about crashing. As you travel to the watchtower, Lucia will mention that the dodo seems to be growing very fast.

As you’re driving to the watchtower, around three miles from the destination, the dodo will begin to make noise, and Lucia will suspect that the dodo is hungry. Jeff will mention a fruit stand that's coming up, and the GPS will switch you to park at the fruit stand.

Once you arrive at the fruit stand, Lucia will exit the car with the bird-bag in hand. Approach the fruit stand and try to feed the dodo different kinds of fruit. After trying to feed it oranges, bananas, and peppers, the bird will knock them all away. Jeff will mention that the dodo is signaling toward something else and realizes that the dodo wants Sprunk, since it’s theorized through the mission dialogue that the egg was injected with Sprunk.

When looking at the fruit stand, look to the left to spot a green Sprunk vending machine. Interact with the machine to feed the dodo some Sprunk.

After giving the dodo one can of Sprunk, Jeff will suggest that you give it another. Lucia will hand the dodo to Jeff, who will then be hit over the head with a watermelon from a man behind him. The man will then steal the dodo and take off on a motorcycle. As the cutscene ends, you’ll be facing the man as he leaves, and right past him is a couple of dirt bikes. Steal one to pursue the man.

While chasing the man, be sure to use Focus Mode ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ) to see his trail, since he has a bit of a head start.

Continue to chase the man until he leaves the highway and starts going off-road. By now, you should have the man in your sights. Continue to chase the man on the motorcycle until you’re close enough, then pull out you pistol while driving and shoot the man in the back. Doing so will cause him to drop the bag. Dismount your bike and retrieve the bag.

Once Lucia has the bag, she will call Jeff and tell him that the dodo needs a vet. Jeff will tell you to go to a vet in Capri to find a veterinarian who makes huge contributions to the Dodos Rising cause but isn’t an official member. The location for the vet office in Capri will be marked on your map and can be found west of your current location.

Once at the PetPep vet and enter through the door in the alley. A cutscene will begin where the vet will explain that he’s a bit annoyed that the Dodos Rising group doesn’t allow him to go on any missions, even though he donates a bunch of money. He’ll take the dodo from the bag, and the dodo will snap at him.

By now, you’ve noticed a common theme that none of the animals during these missions like the Dodos Riding group very much. The vet will put a cone on the dodo and tell Lucia to keep it on for a few days. As Lucia is packing up the dodo, the vet will try to inject Lucia with a sedative. Fight him off to inject the sedative into him instead. Lucia will quickly pack up the dodo, while cars can be heard approaching from outside.

Once you gain control of Lucia, a man with a gun will open the door. Pull out a gun and fight the men off. As you leave the vet building, the alley will be filled with men in suits trying to kill you. Shoot them all down while making sure to keep yourself and the dodo safe. Once all the men are dead, steal one of their cars or hop back on the dirt bike you likely rode here and follow the waypoint to the tower.

While driving to the tower, Lucia will call Jason and ask him to meet her there because trouble is going down. While continuing to follow the waypoint, you’ll be constantly tailed by the men who will be in black SUVs. Continue to shoot the drivers, tires, or front of the vehicles to get away from them.

Once you finally get to the watchtower, a cutscene will play Lucia giving the dodo more Sprunk. As she’s doing this, more men in suits will show up, though this time she won’t be alone. The camera will switch to first-person and show someone approaching the men. It’s Jason to the rescue!

After the cutscene ends, the pair will fight off the men in suits. After taking out about half the men, Jason will tell Lucia that she needs to go to the watchtower to meet Yvonne and finish this. Leave Jason to finish off the remaining men and start running toward the watchtower. Once you're at the watchtower, you’ll see a spiral staircase in the middle. Climb the stairs all the way to the top.

Once at the top, speak to Yvonne to watch the final cutscene. During this cutscene, Yvonne will monologue about how the younger generation doesn’t care about animals and the planet as much as she does. While talking, she will take the dodo out of the bag to set it free. At the edge of the watchtower, Yvonne will toss the bird off the tower so it can fly away. The dodo cannot fly, however, and falls to its death. Tragic.

Once the cutscene ends, Jason and Lucia will be in front of the watchtower. Once you gain control of Lucia, the Dodos Rising optional mission is officially over.

Luckily, it won’t all have been for nothing. After the mission ends, you will eventually receive a text message directly from Yvonne letting you know that the Dodos will likely not contact you anymore, but that they have some money for you. Yvonne will send over $5000 and claim it’s for your efforts, but in reality, it’s so you’ll stay quiet.

articles.title: GTA 6 Has Given Carly Rae Jepsen's Most Underrated Song Another Shot in the Charts
articles.summary: GTA 6 has propelled an underrated hit from Carly Rae Jepsen back into the charts for the first time in more than a decade.
articles.body:
GTA 6 has propelled an underrated hit from Carly Rae Jepsen back into the charts for the first time in more than a decade.

'Run Away With Me' by Carly Rae Jepsen is taking places on multiple music charts after being used in one of GTA 6's most memorable missions. The song's inclusion has many realising that we've been sleeping on this banger for years, after it failed to make much of a dent in the music charts when it was released in 2015.

Kicking off the week, 'Run Away With Me' is 84th on the Shazam music charts. It joins many other tracks that feature in GTA 6, such as 'Break Free' by Ariana Grande (feat Zedd) and 'Flower In A Hurricane' by Justice (feat Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard), the latter of which takes the top spot overall.

'Run Away With Me' is also a new entry on the iTunes charts, taking the 140th spot. As expected, it's there alongside plenty of GTA 6 hits, with the game having a clear effect on the music charts.

The track is still a way off its initial release-window peak, as it reached 49 in the U.S. pop charts. However, this was shockingly low for a song that received widespread acclaim at the time, seen as one of the best songs of the year. So, its GTA 6-spike is giving it another chance to shine.

You'll hear the song in GTA 6 when you're flicking through the radio, but it also takes centre stage during a Chapter 1 mission, Day Release . This is the first time you play as Lucia after the prologue, and the song runs throughout the entire mission, swelling when you jump on a jet ski to get to a yacht party. The song is essentially our introduction to Vice City, and serves as a celebration of Lucia's freedom and hope for a better future.

Now, with GTA 6 selling incredibly well — making an eye-watering $3.79 billion in its first day — we're seeing that success bleed into other mediums. It helps that Rockstar released an official soundtrack right alongside the game, which we're also seeing on the charts, but tracks that didn't even make it onto the album are still performing well.

As many of us are still just scratching the surface of the game, we can expect to see this success continue well into the holiday season. It's no wonder Doja Cat is so eager to get her work into GTA 6 ; any artist would appreiciate this boost.

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . articles.title: Samsung’s absurd 1,100Hz gaming monitor hits shelves next month for $899.99
articles.summary: A year after being announced, Samsung’s 1,100Hz Odyssey G6 gaming monitor is finally being released.
articles.body: After being teased in December 2025 and getting an arguably unnecessary pre-release spec bump in August, the Samsung Odyssey G6 G60H rolls out next month for $899.99. The 27-inch gaming monitor will have an absurd 1,100Hz refresh rate, narrowly edging out LG’s UltraGear 25G590B, which tops out at 1,000Hz. Is there any value in these ultra-fast refresh rates? That’s up for debate. But whether or not you can actually see the difference, it does give the company bragging rights. So there is that, I guess. The G60H will only be able ot hit 1,100Hz in 1080p. Bumping the resolution up to 1440p will drop the refresh rate to 600Hz, which is still absurdly fast. The Dual Mode IPS panel is also the first to feature Samsung’s new Odyssey Clear Motion tech, which reduces motion blur during games. Eventually, the company plans to bring Clear Motion to more gaming monitors. Black Equalizer also makes it easier to see details in dark scenes. Beyond that, the G60H also supports HDR10+, Nvidia G-Sync, and AMD FreeSync Premium.

articles.title: Why You Probably Shouldn't Steal a Tesla in GTA 6
articles.summary: Since GTA 5, Rockstar has parodied the Tesla brand with the fictional Coil line of cars. Well, with GTA 6, Rockstar has taken the Tesla parody to another level.
articles.body:
Since GTA 5 , Rockstar has parodied the Tesla brand with the fictional Coil line of cars. Well, with GTA 6 , Rockstar has taken the Tesla parody to another level.

GTA 6 players have discovered that the game's version of Tesla cars are equipped with advanced security measures that prevent you from stealing the vehicle — and their owners get preferential treatment from the police.

Whenever you try to steal a Coil car, a mechanism kicks in and locks you inside. Then, the car will either drive itself to the nearest police station, or force you to stay put until the cops arrive and arrest you.

Do NOT steal is Tesla in GTA 6 😭 — Lucky Chamu (@LuckyChamu) November 22, 2026

GTA 6. 玩家不能偷老马的特斯拉 偷玩直接被自动驾驶送到警察局 太好玩了 #GTA6 #特斯拉 — ycchong (@ycchong188) November 22, 2026

GTA 6. 玩家不能偷老马的特斯拉 偷玩直接被自动驾驶送到警察局 太好玩了 #GTA6 #特斯拉

Now, there is a way to escape, but you'll still be without the vehicle. It seems that the only way to make it out of there is to bust the window and climb out before the cops arrive. Otherwise, you can try and make a run for it when the cops drag you out of the car, but by that point you're probably surrounded and very much in tasering range.

I hopped in-game to try this out, and found that none of the other Tesla-like electric vehicles produced the same results, so it's likely just the Coils that have this mechanic. You can't steal any of these electric cars until you get a key cloner anyway, but you can hop into one that's already unlocked (by 'borrowing' it from its owner when it's still running) and drive away to safety. They're worth a lot of money and are significantly cheaper to charge up as opposed to filling a car up with gas, so it's a good get if you can nab one.

As for the Coils, you might have more luck if you find one where the security has been deactivated, but it's unclear if that's possible — if it is, we're all still looking for one.

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Goes Heavy on Steve Rogers, as Marvel Keeps Big Reveals Under Wraps
articles.body:
Marvel has released a major new Avengers: Doomsday trailer showing our best look at the film yet, though the studio is seemingly keeping some of its big cards close to its chest.

The footage runs to more than three minutes, making the clip a sizable look compared to the glimpses teased so far. Still, there seems to be much here that Marvel is still keeping under wraps with just a couple of weeks left to go until Doomsday's December launch.

"We made a choice that we knew was right," Steve Rogers says to Peggy Carter, discussing what they have told their new son. "Why does it feel so wrong to lie to him? How's he ever going to know who we are unless we tell him?" Today's trailer focuses heavily on Steve, Peggy and their son — who we now see as a young child for the first time, rather than just as a baby.

The final trailer for Avengers Doomsday has been released — Daniel Richtman (@DanielRPK) November 23, 2026

The final trailer for Avengers Doomsday has been released

"Steven Grant Rogers," Carter replies, "Do you think that boy doesn't know who you are? Every time you walk him to school or kiss him good night, do you think for an instant he doesn't know you?"

After a montage of clips showing Rogers bonding with his boy, who should turn up but... The Fantastic Four. "Are you Steve Rogers?" asks Reed Richards. Yes, yes he is. And it's here that Steve's son finally discovers his dad is a superhero, and Steve handily recounts how the Avengers saved the universe back in Endgame, via a bit of time travel shenanigans.

As fans had expected, the trailer confirms that Doctor Doom is now on the warpath as a result of those shenanigans — and it's not just the Rogers family who are at risk. Thor and Ant-Man are seen with their daughters in clips we've seen previously, while Hawkeye-in-training Kate Bishop is also glimpsed for the first time. (Hailee Steinfeld finally confirmed her inclusion within the film just this weekend.)

As Thor and Steve Rogers give rousing speeches, we see the leadup to what looks like the Avengers' first proper encounter with Doom and the Sentinels, with the X-Men now on-side too. We get to see Bucky reunite with Steve, and Cyclops gets to call the X-Men to him for an epic Avengers-style panning shot. Finally, Thor teases Rogers about his speech, saying it was "average by Cap standards" — yet more Sam Wilson erasure!

Fans had expected today's trailer to drop around now , thanks to the loose lips of Peggy Carter actress Hayley Atwell. We also now have a good idea of how long the final film will last.

Avengers: Doomsday launches on December 18.
